bullets: A natural voice. Meldmind can now speak in a warm, human-sounding voice that runs on this PC for free. Get it once in Settings > Voice (about 88 MB), pick one of 6 voices and a speed, and play a sample.
The top left button opens History in Simple and Expert. Expert's sidebar keeps its own Hide button, and History no longer sits in the middle of it.
History is easier to read: the same calm, even text sizes as the Expert sidebar.
